# Glue pairs {#sec-glue}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/edges.R")
library(DT)
edges <- if (file.exists("_generated/edges.csv")) read_edges("_generated/edges.csv")
```

Every edge number is printed twice in the template: once on the edge and once on the tab that is glued to it. The converter measures the edge each number sits on and pairs the two. A pair is *matching* when it found exactly one edge and one tab of the same length (status `ok`); anything else needs a look. `A` is the first piece of the pair, `B` its partner, lengths in mm.

```{r}
if (is.null(edges)) {
  cat("The edge-number check (output/bowser/bowser-edges.csv) has not been run yet.\n")
} else {
  edges |>
    filter(!is.na(length_diff_mm), side != "none", partner_side != "none") |>
    ggplot(aes(length_diff_mm, fill = verdict)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(matching = "#2e7d32", `needs work` = "#d32f2f")) +
    labs(x = "length difference between the two edges (mm)", y = "edge numbers", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r}
#| column: page
if (!is.null(edges)) {
  glue_pairs(edges) |>
    mutate(across(c(verdict, status, side_a, side_b, ocr_a), factor)) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
      colnames = c("Number", "Verdict", "Status", "Piece A", "Side A", "Length A",
                   "Piece B", "Side B", "Length B", "Diff", "A read"),
      options = list(pageLength = 25)
    ) |>
    formatStyle("verdict", color = styleEqual(c("matching", "needs work"), c("#2e7d32", "#d32f2f")),
                fontWeight = "bold")
}
```
